{{Quote|We have no agreement. And with each day that passes, our assurances of support from the Malarians and the Keitumites that they will follow our lead diminishes. It is critical that this matter be decided.|Kandah|<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
'''Keitumites''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Keitum system/Legends|Keitum system]] and one of the seven species in the [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]].<ref name="AS" />
